claims.text: Managing seasonal profiles
claims.note: Tile title. The slots default to the four seasons plus Tournament.

claims.text: A profile per season and per event.
claims.note: Tile summary. Default slot names are SPATIAL_ADJUST.PROFILE_SPRING "Spring", PROFILE_SUMMER "Summer", PROFILE_FALL "Fall", PROFILE_WINTER "Winter" and PROFILE_TOURNAMENT "Tournament".

claims.text: A small set of profiles, one per condition, is easier to run a season with than a long list of dated snapshots.
claims.note: Editorial. The product enforces a small set: five slots per course (SpatialAdjustLogic.cs:28-31), so a long list of dated snapshots is not possible.

claims.text: Settings › Target Profiles
claims.note: Settings gear, then the third rail entry.

claims.text: The Target Profiles tab lists five named profile slots for each Lynx course.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (seasonal-profiles/note/1); docs/text-corrections.md §11 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: Target Profiles is still in development and is not in the shipping build yet.

claims.text: If your settings dialog has no Target Profiles entry, your IntelliDash has not yet been updated to the release that includes it.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (seasonal-profiles/note/2); docs/text-corrections.md §11 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: The screens here show a proposed design; the tab being built lists five named profile slots, so what you see on your own screen may differ.

claims.text: The Spatial Adjust dashboard, at /spatialadjust.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understand-spatial-adjust/where/1; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: The Target Profiles tab of the Settings dialog.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim target-profiles/1/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Profiles captured for the conditions you plan for.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims seasonal-profiles/1/1, seasonal-profiles/1/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Capturing profiles shows how.
claims.note: Cross-reference to the guide on capturing a profile (Update from Current icon, sa-settings-dlg.component.html:207-212).

claims.text: Applying a profile is a course-wide recalculation, so treat it as a planned change rather than a quick switch.
claims.note: Retyped from prerequisite to behaviour; 373-1135 rev 02 predates Target Profiles. The apply runs as a background job after Save Changes, with progress in the dialog footer (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:139-177, :505-526), and recalculates the matching stations' suggestions (SpatialAdjustService.cs:861-936). The planning advice is the guide's.

claims.text: Lynx itself must be set up to match Spatial Adjust.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 p.1 lists the Lynx settings Spatial Adjust depends on: Site Adjust and Course Adjust, Pct. Adjust, and Next Amt.

claims.text: Push changes to Lynx lists the settings under Before you start.
claims.note: Cross-reference within the guides: push-to-lynx/before/4 to /before/9 carry the settings, each from 373-1135 rev 02 §Settings Configuration, p.1.

claims.text: Plan what goes in the five slots
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (seasonal-profiles/1/1); docs/text-corrections.md §12 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.

claims.text: In the [[Target Profile]] column, name each slot for a condition you plan for.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims creating-profiles/3/1, creating-profiles/3/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: Three or four profiles covers most courses: a summer baseline, a shoulder-season set, a tournament set, and a recovery set for after aeration or overseed.

claims.text: Each box shows its new name, such as Summer Baseline or Tournament Week.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim creating-profiles/3/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: If a new name is lost, the dialog was cancelled.
claims.note: Cancel with unsaved changes asks whether to discard them; choosing Discard changes closes the dialog and loses the names (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:217-229).

claims.text: Rename the slot again and select [[Save Changes]].
With only 5 slots per course, name each one for a condition, not a date.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim creating-profiles/3/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: A short list stays readable a year later.
claims.note: Editorial. The product fixes the list at five slots per course.

claims.text: Apply the evening before
claims.note: Mechanically sound: an applied target persists on the station, so the next day's adjustment is computed against it (SpatialAdjustService.cs:3033), and nothing reaches Lynx before a push. Whether the evening before is the right time is an operational judgement.
claims.question: Is applying a seasonal profile the evening before, then reviewing the suggestions against the next morning's scan, the recommended way to switch profiles?

claims.text: On the profile’s row, select the icon under [[Apply Profile]].
claims.previousText: Applying rewrites the target of every station in the profile and recalculates their suggestions; stations not in the profile keep their targets.

claims.text: The [[Use Target Profile?]] dialog opens, with a count of [[Matching Stations]].
claims.note: The confirmation is titled SPATIAL_ADJUST.USE_TARGET_PROFILE "Use Target Profile?" and its summary table has a SPATIAL_ADJUST.MATCHING_STATIONS "Matching Stations" row (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:272-314).

claims.text: If nothing opens, you may have cleared an earlier choice on that row.
claims.note: onApplyTargetProfile toggles: when the row is already marked it clears the mark and returns without opening the dialog (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:257-261).

claims.text: Select the icon again.
claims.note: A second selection after clearing opens the confirmation (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:263-265).

claims.text: Doing it the evening before leaves you the next morning to read the new suggestions against a fresh scan.
claims.note: When the next scan arrives the server computes that day's adjustment from the fresh scan and the station's current Target VWC, which is the applied profile's value (SpatialAdjustService.cs:3001-3043).

claims.text: Apply, then review the next morning’s suggestions.
claims.note: Figure caption. The timing advice is the open question on seasonal-profiles/2/1.

claims.text: Confirm the profile
In the [[Use Target Profile?]] dialog, select [[Confirm]].
claims.note: The dialog confirm button is STRINGS.CONFIRM "Confirm" (uppercased on screen) and calls onApplyProfile (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:276-279).

claims.text: The dialog closes, and an exclamation mark on the icon shows the profile will be applied on save.
claims.note: Confirming sets applyProfile on the chosen slot and closes the dialog; the exclamation icon has tooltip "Will be applied on save" (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:216).

claims.text: If there is no exclamation mark, the choice was cancelled.
claims.note: Cancel closes the dialog and leaves applyProfile unset (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:281-285), so no mark appears.

claims.text: Select the icon under [[Apply Profile]] again.
claims.note: A second selection on a marked row clears the mark (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:257-261); a further selection then opens the confirmation again (:263-265).

claims.text: Stations in the profile that are no longer scanned are skipped, which is why [[Matching Stations]] can be lower.
claims.note: The dialog warns when matching stations differ from the stations saved in the profile and says "Matching stations will be updated, while unmatched stations will be ignored." (SPATIAL_ADJUST.PROFILE_UNMATCHED_STATIONS_WARNING).

claims.text: A chosen profile waits for Save Changes.
claims.note: SPATIAL_ADJUST.USE_TARGET_PROFILE_INFO says the replacement happens when you save; the mark is only a flag on the dialog until onSave sends it.

claims.text: Save the change
Select [[Save Changes]] at the bottom of the dialog.
claims.previousText: The push dialog is the same as any other day.

claims.text: A busy sign shows while the profile is applied, then the dialog closes and the dashboard reloads.
claims.note: onSave sets isBusy, which shows the waiting indicator (html:45), waits for the queued profile operation to finish, then reloads the dashboard through saBulkAdjustCompleted and closes (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:201-209, :543-546).
claims.previousText: The difference is the size of the change set: a profile switch usually queues most of the course at once.

claims.text: If the dialog stays open with [[Unable to save data]], the save did not finish.
claims.note: On error onSave shows the generic save error, GENERIC_SAVE_ERROR_SUMMARY "Unable to save data", and does not emit save, so the dialog stays open (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:208-213).

claims.text: Reload the page and check the profile list before you try again.
claims.note: The profile operation can fail or time out after ten minutes with advice to refresh before trying again (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:510-518); a failed save does not reload the list, so reloading is the way to see what was stored.

claims.text: Nothing is applied until Save Changes.
Read the new suggestions before pushing
claims.note: Step title. Applying never pushes; the push is a separate step.

claims.text: Read the [[Suggested]] column the next morning.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims seasonal-profiles/2/3, seasonal-profiles/2/4; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Stations far below their new target rise toward the cap; stations far above it fall toward 0%.
claims.note: The amount is the target minus the working VWC plus today’s adjusted ET, capped at the daily maximum and floored at 0 (SpatialAdjustLogic.cs:64-91). Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim seasonal-profiles/3/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: If the profile’s name is not above the table, it was not applied, or a target has been edited since.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim target-profiles/verify/1; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: A profile changes targets, and targets change deficits.
claims.note: Delta = Target VWC − modelled VWC (SpatialAdjustService.cs:3033).

claims.text: New targets, new suggestions — review before pushing.
claims.note: Figure caption.

claims.text: Open Push Changes
At the right of the toolbar, select [[Push Changes]].
claims.note: Push Changes is the first control in the toolbar’s right-hand group, #sa-tb-right, and opens the push dialog (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:33-42, :94-99).
claims.previousText: At the bottom of the [[Push Changes]] dialog, select the push button.

claims.text: The [[Push Changes]] dialog opens, with the changes it will send.
claims.note: The dialog is headed Push Changes and lists the stations available to push and those already pushed today (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.html:14-30, :68-104).

claims.text: If [[Push Changes]] is greyed out, nothing is waiting.
claims.note: The button is disabled when stationsPendingUpdate is empty or a push is running (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:34).
claims.previousText: If the [[Push Changes]] dialog is not open, select [[Push Changes]] at the right of the toolbar.

claims.text: Check that the profile was applied.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim target-profiles/verify/1; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: After a profile, the button’s count, as in Push 148 changes to Lynx, is often most of the course.

claims.text: Push Changes sits at the left of the toolbar’s right-hand group.
claims.note: Push Changes is the first child of #sa-tb-right, ahead of the Pushed Today counter and the tool buttons (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:33-47).

claims.text: Push once you agree with them
claims.note: Step title.

claims.text: Select the footer button of the [[Push Changes]] dialog, such as Push 148 changes to Lynx.
claims.note: The dialog footer has a Push button labelled STRINGS.PUSH_N_CHANGES_TO_LYNX "Push {{num}} changes to Lynx" and a Cancel button (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.html:142-147). The number in the guide is an example.

claims.text: A progress dialog opens and counts the stations as they are sent to Lynx.
claims.note: Push progress is reported as LYNX_PUSH_PUSHING "Pushing Percent Adjustments to Lynx ({{index}} of {{count}})" (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:189-200).

claims.text: If the [[Push Changes]] dialog is not open, select [[Push Changes]] at the right of the toolbar first.
After a profile, the count on that button is often most of the course.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims seasonal-profiles/4/3, seasonal-profiles/4/4; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: A profile switch queues a large push.
claims.note: Figure caption.

claims.text: Review it as one.
claims.note: Editorial.

claims.text: Push window. Push between 11 AM and the synchronisation time set in Lynx, and synchronise Lynx after the push.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 p.10 gives the window, 11 AM to the synchronisation time set in Lynx, and says to synchronise after the push. It names no time zone and does not say how to synchronise. Published before the answer by the guides owner's decision of 2026-10-19, for the in-person review on 2026-10-22 (docs/claims/operational-contract.md § Publishing).
claims.question: Q1 and Q2 (docs/claims/operational-contract.md): is the 11 AM in the course's local time or US Eastern Time, and does the synchronisation Lynx runs at its scheduled time pick up an earlier push, or must the superintendent synchronise Lynx by hand after every push?

claims.text: Outside that window the push does not reach the course, and no error tells you so.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 gives the window but never says what happens outside it, and IntelliDash has no push-window logic. Published before the answer by the guides owner's decision of 2026-10-19, for the in-person review on 2026-10-22 (docs/claims/operational-contract.md § Publishing).
claims.question: Q3 and Q4: does a push made after the Lynx synchronisation time, or before 11 AM, fail to reach the course, and does anything in Spatial Adjust or Lynx report it? (The push dialog would still verify the values against Lynx and report success.)

claims.text: The dashboard names the intended profile above the table, for example “Summer Target Profile”.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (seasonal-profiles/verify/1); docs/text-corrections.md §13 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: The intended profile is marked active.

claims.text: You reviewed the recalculated suggestions before pushing.
claims.note: A self-check; the suggestions are on the dashboard after the reload.
